prologue.text: Santa! Me again. Great meeting. One of the best meetings I've ever had.
Just out of curiosity... where do you keep the List?

l1.text: Santa! Heard you beat Frost. Fantastic. Tremendous fight, I'm told. Tremendous.
Word travels. I have the best people. Keep it up, big things are coming. Huge.

l2.text: Santa! Krampus. Horns. I knew he'd be there.
I know things. Everybody says I know things. Great job, by the way. Very strong. Very goat-free.

l3.text: Santa! Paper. The biggest paper deal in history, and you got it for nothing. Tremendous negotiating. I'd have done it faster.
Ebenezer gave it up himself, in the end.
Sure, sure. And Golden Tower, total disaster of a company. Sad. I barely know them.
...Sir? How do you know that name? We haven't read it out to anyone yet.
Golden Tower? It's... it's what I'd call a building. If I built one. Which I might. Great call, everybody. Bye.

l4.text: Santa! Iceland. Beautiful country. Very cold. I hear you lost contact with the wife?
Very common. Happens to the best people. Do NOT go back. Go to Sleepy Hollow. Big race there. Huge. You'll love it.
